names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name link for 6 мая ст. ст., «Дионисий Фракийский, мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The day’s line declines him «Мчч. Варвара воина, Вакха, Каллимаха и Дионисия», so the epithet is the name link’s and not the line’s.

death.note: The day line closes the four of them «(ок. 362)», about 362, and the life they share gives the year plainly for the last of them: «святой Варвар окончил свой славный подвиг и в 362 году был усечен мечом». This man was beheaded in the course of that same torture, several days before it ended, so the year is the one the source gives for the company and the «ок.» of the line is recorded here rather than in the interval.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 мая ст. ст. — «Мчч. Варвара воина, Вакха, Каллимаха и Дионисия (ок. 362).»

attestations.note: The line enumerates four men by name and the calendar carries a separate `/name/` link for each of the four, so by docs/CORPUS.md §10.1 it is four folders and not one. Checked for an existing folder before writing: the corpus keeps thirty-five Dionysius folders, and none of them is a soldier of Julian’s — a grep of all of them for the year 362 returns only `dionysius-of-glushitsa`, a fifteenth-century Russian abbot; the seventeen folders the corpus keeps on the menologion’s 6/5 in any calendar contain no Dionysius; and fk.mjs on «Дионисий Фракийский» and on «Dionysius of Thrace» returns NONE. The day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
